paragraphs.text: AnaMaria Curtis is a speculative fiction writer from the countryside of Illinois, USA.

Her work has been published in magazines including Clarkesworld , Uncanny , and Strange Horizons . She’s a winner of the LeVar Burton Reads Origins & Encounters Writing Contest and the 2019 Dell Magazines Award .
For Wizards of the Coast , Curtis wrote a Magic Story for Edge of Eternities .
